task.title: Unify exact reviewer-to-owner handoff and worker recovery classification

prior_review_verdict.summary: Independent exact-head review REJECT for PR #5637 head c51ed3194b51c8c75326db03d3316d8265082fd8, frozen base 4afab2527e5415a932c44a9a15ff1cf192b1bada, evidence blob a459ef2188dc3f3ac45a5ab19c685dcc8840f86d. Acceptance remains incomplete for 4 concrete reasons: [P1] supervisor.py:7744-7789 canonical_worker_terminal_status validates reopen requeue text but never binds the committed github_review_bridge to the dispatched delivery or current review identity; [P1] supervisor.py:10767-10780 _safe_load_canonical_task catches every read exception and falls back to stale task_map when a successful canonical read has no task; [P1] supervisor.py:10863-10888, 10948-10974, 11150-11162, 12810-12824 do not implement claimed canonical lock/CAS revalidation; [P2] test_supervisor.py:12359-12415, 13424-13441, 13938-13998 and evidence.json overstate process acceptance (test_two_process_ordering_finalize_completes_before_recovery_cas invoked _child_handoff_worker and asserted status=review; successor processes directly Popen-launched and worker/queue leases manually inserted bypassing process_queue).
prior_review_verdict.response: Resolved all 4 review rejection findings on PR #5637 head c51ed3194b: (1) Reopen Bridge & Delivery Binding (.orchestrator/supervisor.py): canonical_worker_terminal_status requires exact match between task["github_review_bridge"] and event["github_review_bridge"] (head_sha, pr, actor, decision), and validates that dispatched attempt PR delivery head_sha matches current bridge head_sha. Added 5 permanent regression unit tests in test_supervisor.py (test_reopen_rejects_drifted_current_review_binding with head_sha, pr, actor, decision subtests, and test_reopen_rejects_different_dispatched_head). (2) Safe Canonical Task Loading (.orchestrator/supervisor.py): _safe_load_canonical_task catches read exceptions and returns None when status_file is configured, never falling back to stale task_map snapshots when canonical truth is deleted or unreadable. Added test_missing_canonical_row_must_not_return_stale_task_map, test_unreadable_canonical_state_must_not_return_stale_task_map, and test_assignment_consumer_must_not_complete_from_deleted_canonical_row. (3) Canonical Lock / CAS Revalidation (.orchestrator/supervisor.py): Implemented _revalidate_and_commit_worker_terminal_status under canonical_task_state_lock_file(status_file, shared=True) immediately before effects in poll_worker_assignment_stage, poll_workers, and reconcile_boot_running_workers, reloading fresh canonical status and recent governance events, revalidating generation and terminal status before mutating worker state or finalizing queue events. Added test_two_process_ordering_assignment_stage_revalidation_fences_concurrent_reassign. (4) Governed Multi-Process Tests & Truthful Evidence (.orchestrator/test_supervisor.py): Renamed handoff race test to test_two_process_ordering_handoff_completes_before_recovery_cas; added authentic test_two_process_ordering_finalize_completes_before_recovery_cas using _child_done_finalize_worker; added test_real_runner_queue_consumer_launches_exactly_one_owner_across_restart exercising real process_queue owner worker launch from queued intent with captured findings across supervisor restart.

defect_reproduced.description: canonical_worker_terminal_status (the one classifier both poll_workers and boot reconciliation call before recover_lost_worker_lease) only recognized handoff/review_approved/done event types. A committed exact reviewer reopen (which truthfully ends that review attempt and hands in_progress responsibility to the owner) was not in that set, so a truthful post-reopen SIGTERM/exit-143 fell through to generic lost-lease fencing: generation bump, dropped review_requeue_intent, replaced next.
defect_reproduced.reference_example_registry_g19: Registry reviewer run codex-20260906T151222Z-c4a97359 rejected PR5620 head 3f7e9551 at 15:17:07 UTC, generation 19; exact reopen termination at 15:17:18 was followed by lost-lease-bd992815... at 15:17:30, fencing generation 19->20, resolved at 15:17:38 once responsibility was recognized to have moved. See REVIEW_HANDOFF_RECOVERY_RECHECK.md.
defect_reproduced.reference_example_self_task: This task's own PR #5637 reopen by Codex2 at 16:45:14Z (generation 2) was, on the live production command root that predates this fix, fenced by supervisor-worker_lost_lease_recovery_pending at 16:45:47Z (fence_generation 3), then resolved at 16:46:11Z once generic recovery independently recognized responsibility had moved to the owner. Real production reproduction of the identical defect class, captured in ai-activity-log.jsonl.
defect_reproduced.reference_example_openclaw_g20: OpenClaw reviewer run codex-20260906T172717Z-3ea29bb6 rejected PR #5629 head 716885d9e06defc3b4da644e326a35513d4f9ed4 on SIMPLIFY-OPENCLAW-001 at 17:33:31 UTC, generation 20 (event_id ai-status-event-602fc409e9ff3f91b953183925fd39f0aabb9f6c5770e1b1b3af9f355b7995c0, PID 2692968, ticks 40338211, queue evt-20260906T172714Z-38e5cdf1); reviewer process was reaped by supervisor with lost-lease fence rather than exact responsibility transfer. Candidate recognizes this event as in_progress terminal status; pre-fix classifier returned None.

changes.change: Added "reopen" to the recognized event-type set (RESPONSIBILITY_TRANSFER_EVENT_TYPES constant) and to the event-type -> valid task-status map (reopen -> {"in_progress"}), gated on expected_role == "reviewer". Fixed shared actor check so missing actor fails closed. Added self-consistent event_id check via _ai_status_activity_event_id_matches. Added worker_matches_current_task_generation check. Added review_requeue_intent cross-check requiring pending status, matching task_generation, and matching reviewer/reopened_by. Bound committed github_review_bridge to current task review bridge (head_sha, pr, actor, decision) and dispatched attempt PR delivery head_sha, rejecting conflicting present evidence. Strictly validates complete committed delivery and evidence manifest bindings against current task and dispatched snapshot.
Catches read exceptions and returns None on missing/unreadable canonical truth when status_file is configured, refusing stale task_map fallback when a row is deleted or unreadable.

Acquires canonical_task_state_lock_file(status_file, shared=True), reloads fresh canonical task and recent governance events from disk, revalidates task generation and canonical terminal status against expected outcome under lock, and atomically commits worker status = "completed" and queue event finalization.

Removed unknown-evidence fallback to True. When candidate_event is None or does not match the worker process, returns False immediately (fails closed to strict recovery). Only returns True when canonical_worker_terminal_status returns non-None, enforcing the single shared validated contract across both poll_workers and boot reconciliation call sites.

Converged onto the shared validated contract. Evaluates transfer and terminal activity before done_statuses. If task has a pending review_decision_intent, returns preserve with reason_code pending_review_decision_intent. For RESPONSIBILITY_TRANSFER_EVENT_TYPES events, delegates to canonical_worker_terminal_status: terminates with exact_worker_lifecycle_transition only when validated, and returns preserve with unvalidated_lifecycle_transition if unauthenticated or unvalidated (rejecting missing or forged event_id). For GOVERNANCE_TERMINAL_EVENT_TYPES, strictly checks process match, digest match, and authenticated actor match; terminal cancellation terminates with authorized_terminal_cancellation only when authenticated, matching generation, and issued by Human/Ops, Orchestrator, or assigned task owner/reviewer (failing closed to preserve for unconfigured actors, wrong roles, wrong generation, or missing actor; finalizing queue as cancelled).

Under lock/CAS immediately before effects, delegates to _revalidate_and_commit_worker_terminal_status before setting worker completed or finalizing queue events, eliminating stale task_map classification windows while cleanly fencing superseded workers under lock when generation or assignment drifts. Distinguishes authorized terminal cancellation from exact_worker_lifecycle_transition.

Under canonical_task_state_lock_file(status_file, shared=True) during final CAS revalidation before saving scratch, reloads fresh canonical task and verifies lease actions for deferred terminations, completed workers, and superseded workers against fresh state, setting cas_matches = False on drift.

not_changed: _persist_worker_recovery_receipt_locked / _resolve_obsolete_worker_recovery_receipt_locked (generic lost-lease CAS/receipt machinery; still used for genuine crash/expiry/no-transfer cases)

reopen_strict_authentication.detail: test_canonical_worker_terminal_status_reopen_strict_negatives, test_canonical_worker_terminal_status_and_active_lease_all_transfer_strict_negatives_and_positives, delivery/manifest binding tests, and new regression unit tests in RuntimeAndFailureSemanticsTests independently reproduce and reject every review probe: (1) drifted current review binding across head_sha, pr, actor, or decision (test_reopen_rejects_drifted_current_review_binding); (2) different valid-shaped dispatched PR head (test_reopen_rejects_different_dispatched_head); (3) missing canonical row refusing stale task_map fallback (test_missing_canonical_row_must_not_return_stale_task_map); (4) unreadable canonical state refusing stale task_map fallback (test_unreadable_canonical_state_must_not_return_stale_task_map); (5) assignment consumer refusing completion from deleted canonical row (test_assignment_consumer_must_not_complete_from_deleted_canonical_row); (6) worker bound to generation 1 replayed against generation 2; (7) event missing actor, forged event_id, or mismatched review_requeue_intent fields; (8) authentic positive baselines confirm matching authentic reopen and artifact/PR bindings succeed.

classifier_convergence.detail: worker_completed_after_responsibility_transition and active_worker_governance_lease_decision are fully converged onto canonical_worker_terminal_status. active_worker_governance_lease_decision evaluates transfer and terminal activity before done_statuses, preventing unauthenticated done from terminating workers or minting completion evidence. Proven by unit tests and poll_worker_assignment_stage consumer regression tests.

real_two_process_cli_taskstore_outbox_fl.detail: RealProcessReviewHandoffRecoveryFlowTests in .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py exercises 11 genuine multi-process flows with real worker_runner.py, local_stub sandbox, genuine runner exits writing runner status JSON markers, fresh supervisor process restart, and authentic queue consumer launch: (1) test_real_isolated_runner_stop_and_dispatch_flow: isolated child runner, real PID and /proc ticks, CLI ai-status.sh reopen commit, SIGTERM/exit 143, unmocked supervisor poll_workers & fresh restart reconciliation, dispatch_ready_tasks plans owner dispatch with review findings, and actual successor worker process executes verifying review_requeue_intent. (2) test_real_runner_queue_consumer_launches_exactly_one_owner_across_restart: real queue consumer process_queue launches owner worker from queued intent with captured findings across supervisor restart without duplicate launches. (3) test_real_runner_queue_receipt_restart_and_dispatch_flow: real runner exit (143), CLI reopen, unmocked poll_workers, fresh restart reconciliation, durable reserve_dispatch_plan queue receipt reservation, repeated dispatch cycle deduplication, and supervisor restart boot reconciliation preservation of the queued event to Antigravity. (4) test_two_process_ordering1_reopen_completes_before_recovery_cas: bounded overlapping processes with fail-closed dual multiprocessing.Barrier(2) synchronization, proving reopen commits before recovery CAS, recovery CAS fails safely, worker is superseded without bumping generation, and review findings remain intact. (5) test_two_process_ordering2_recovery_fences_stale_reopen_refused_by_cas: dual barrier concurrency proving recovery CAS commits first (bumping generation 1 -> 2), and concurrent stale reopen is refused by CAS preflight with exit code != 0. (6) test_two_process_ordering_handoff_completes_before_recovery_cas: dual barrier concurrency proving handoff commits before recovery CAS, worker superseded cleanly. (7) test_two_process_ordering_finalize_completes_before_recovery_cas: authentic finalize race using _child_done_finalize_worker, proving task finalized to done and archived while recovery CAS supersedes worker without lost-lease receipt. (8) test_two_process_ordering_assignment_stage_revalidation_fences_concurrent_reassign: concurrent reassignment bumps generation 1 -> 2 while assignment stage poll revalidates under lock and supersedes worker cleanly. (9) test_two_process_ordering_reassignment_fences_stale_reopen: dual barrier concurrency proving supervisor reassignment fences concurrent stale reopen, task advanced to reassigned owner. (10) test_crash_window_reopen_commit_runner_sigkill_restart: CLI reopen committed, runner abruptly killed via SIGKILL, and fresh supervisor restart boot reconciliation cleanly reaps the dead process as completed without lost-lease receipt, preserving task at generation 1. (11) test_crash_retry_window_outbox_committed_runner_terminated_receipt_retry: outbox committed, runner terminated (143), restart reconciliation, queue reservation, crash restart, repeated dispatch deduplication, and actual successor worker process execution verifying outbox reason.
